title: A Great Way to Experience Barcelona
text: A great city.  A great guide (Senem).  Outstanding food.  Interesting stories.  A wonderful opportunity to learn about the culture, the food, and the history of the Gracias Neighborhood and the City of Barcelona.  I highly recommend the experience.
author: John_Markey_NB

title: Like hanging out with a friend
text: Pam was awesome. It was like visiting a friend who lives in Barcelona. The time flew by and it was great to taste all the different flavors of the city. I particularly loved tasting the local cheese!
author: bichhap2024

title: If you are in Barcelona, you should not miss this tour
text: Pam greatly impressed me and my three friends visiting from New York and D.C. with her encyclopedic knowledge, her evident passion for delicious food and Barcelona, and her winning personality.  Her food tour gave us insights into the day-to-day life of a real neighborhood that we would not have gotten from a guidebook geared toward a more tourist experience.  I highly recommend this tour and if I came back to Barcelona would book another one.
author: Road44012352425

title: Unforgettable Culinary Experience Thanks to Senem
text: If you're considering this tour, ask for Senem! She was informative, engaging, and provided great cultural background on each dish without overwhelming us. The menu selection was top-tier, covering a wonderful spectrum of savory, sweet, salty, and sour bites. On top of that, her itinerary management was seamless—we visited every restaurant and shop at optimal times when they weren't busy at all. 10/10 experience!
author: kathleenpR6767RL

title: You won't be sorry you booked this food tour!
text: We had a fabulous experience on this food tour! The logistics and pacing of the tour was well-designed, the food was wonderful, and the tour guide, Senem, was knowledgeable and friendly. We learned so much and got to visit excellent places that would not have been on our radar otherwise. Highly recommend!
author: 498bethy

title: Great time.  Recommend.
text: We had a great time learning about Catalonia and Gracia with Pam.  She had enough information and history on the area to fill the tour and tied it all together to give us a better understanding of the people living there.  We stopped at locations that helped us connect.   Her experience, expertise, and pride for the area gave us things to reflect on our entire trip as well as after we left.   A big take away…we are all more similar than we initially imagined.
author: D8825OTbrianf

title: Wonderful
text: Senem, our guide, was a gem. Personable, professional, gave us foods I had never tried. We also learned about Catalonia through the foods we ate. I couldn't have asked for a better food tour guide. She also went above and beyond by giving us suggestions of where else to visit and where to eat.
author: T8003LXmarciaf

title: Excellent Barcelona food tour
text: Excellent food tour experience! We have been to Spain a couple times and are quite interested in food, but Senem was able to introduce us to many things we have never encountered. She was great at answering our questions and making the whole experience memorable.
author: RakeshG20

title: Best tour for traditional food!
text: Our tour guide Ivan was extremely informative and well spoken. There was a lot of great traditional food we sampled and this tour was the best bang for buck out of all the ones we booked. (We had 4 walking/food tours this trip)
author: S8230DSstephanien

title: Culinary Backstreets Barcelona - Made it Catalonia Tour
text:
As foodies, I always research new places we visit with a view to sampling the authentic food of the area. I kept coming across Culinary Backstreets and was impressed by the reviews, so we booked their afternoon/evening private Made in Catalonia – Barcelona tour.

Having now experienced it, I have to add my own praise for the company, and in particular our tour guide, Senem.
